evidence.name: Screen field: How thick the progress bar is
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How thick the progress bar is" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How thick the progress bar is
sections.description: Height of the filled bar in pixels (0-50, default 4px). 4-8px reads as a clean, modern bar; go thicker only for a bold, attention-grabbing indicator. Set it equal to or greater than the track thickness so the fill sits flush over the track instead of looking sunken.
